evidence_note: Status 'fixed' means a regression test exists and passed in the final validation run; see test_matrix.md for the mapping. 'known_gap' items are documented risks, not silently ignored.

issues.title: docker-compose omitted APP_SECRET_KEY/JWT_SECRET so the API and worker crashed at import
issues.reproduction: docker compose up with a filled .env -> api/worker exit with pydantic ValidationError (app_secret_key Field required)
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_config.py (8 tests)
issues.residual_risk: None known; .env.example documents both secrets

issues.title: Routers injected the ORM User where services/agents expected AuthUser; user.permissions/projects became unawaited coroutines
issues.reproduction: POST /query -> RuntimeWarning 'coroutine User.projects was never awaited'; tool permission checks compared against a coroutine
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_auth_user_flow.py
issues.residual_risk: None known

issues.title: Login required an OAuth2 form; QUICKSTART documents JSON {email,password} -> documented flow returned 422
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_auth_login_contract.py (7 tests)
issues.residual_risk: Login rate limiting is in-memory single-process; multi-worker deployments need Redis-backed limiting (documented)

issues.title: Refresh token accepted as a URL query parameter (logs/proxies) and login had no brute-force protection
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_auth_login_contract.py (refresh body contract + 429 + window recovery)
issues.residual_risk: No refresh-token revocation store (denylist) - tokens valid until expiry

issues.title: Reranker imported FlagEmbedding.FlagLLMModel which does not exist -> every hybrid_reranked retrieval raised ImportError
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_reranker.py (fake-module contract tests)
issues.residual_risk: Real-model runtime behavior only validated against the documented API shape (FlagReranker); no GPU/live-model run in this environment

issues.title: effective_from/to were selected but never filtered; expired and future documents were fully retrievable (freshness was a score nudge only)
issues.reproduction: Seed an expired doc (effective_to=yesterday) -> default retrieval returned it
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_freshness.py (12 tests incl. range intersection semantics)
issues.residual_risk: CURRENT_DATE is the DB server clock; keep containers timezone-aligned (documented in freshness.py)

issues.title: NULL-bound optional filters made asyncpg raise AmbiguousParameterError - the retrieval SQL had never actually executed end-to-end
issues.reproduction: dense_retrieve without a department filter -> could not determine data type of parameter $5
issues.test_evidence: All RBAC/freshness/agent integration tests now execute the SQL
issues.residual_risk: None known

issues.title: RRF ranks were 0-based (paper uses 1-based) and fused scores mutated shared input objects in place
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_rrf_fuse.py (exact 1/(k+1) values, non-mutation)
issues.residual_risk: None known

issues.title: All four RBAC security tests were empty pass stubs
issues.test_evidence: Real seeded-document tests: manager-only chunk never leaks via dense/lexical/hybrid; user-allowlist isolation; role spoofing in body ignored; soft-deleted excluded
issues.residual_risk: Project/department-based policies are exercised only via the SQL function (no real project rows exist in the app yet)

issues.title: No re-plan loop: state.py documented a bounded retry loop but the orchestrator terminated on the first insufficient-evidence verdict; any tool exception killed the query
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_agent_loop.py (replan with feedback, exhaustion abstains, per-step tolerance, all-steps-fail)
issues.residual_risk: Mock planner never emits search_by_date, so temporal rows needing expired docs under the agent path rely on the current chunk carrying both facts (corpus designed accordingly); real planners should use search_by_date

issues.title: Nothing imported the tool modules in the app path - the registry was EMPTY and every execute_tool raised 'Unknown tool'
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_planner.py asserts all four tools registered; agent happy path executes search_documents
issues.residual_risk: None known

issues.title: Planner prompt never documented tool schemas, so planners hallucinated args (e.g. {"query"}) that the registry rejected
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_planner.py (prompt contains schemas; sanitize drops unknown tools/out-of-schema args; caps steps)
issues.residual_risk: Sanitizer drops invalid steps silently at runtime; dropped steps kept on Plan.dropped for observability but not yet exported to traces

issues.title: Citation verifier validated the evidence against itself (CLAIMS were built from citation snippets = chunk content); out-of-range markers silently dropped while the answer kept citing them; duplicates not deduped; no abstention path
issues.reproduction: Answer citing a real chunk with a claim the chunk does not support -> judge saw the chunk text as the 'claim' and approved
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_citation_validation.py (12 tests) + tests/integration/test_citation_flow.py (6 tests)
issues.residual_risk: Under the mock provider the judge auto-approves (cross-product true) - real-provider judging is implemented but not runtime-tested here (BLOCKED: no real key in this environment)

issues.title: Layer-1 input classifier (classify_input) was never called anywhere; the output sanitizer (sanitize_output) was never wired into the pipeline
issues.test_evidence: test_agent_loop.py::test_query_level_injection_screen, test_citation_flow.py::test_injection_echo_in_answer_blocked
issues.residual_risk: Classifier judge failure is conservative-allow by design; regex bypasses are possible (documented); no adversarial training

issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_tool_registry.py (7 tests) + agent_loop versions-tool test

issues.test_evidence: YAML now parses; triggers are [main, develop]/[main]; gates assert on real metrics and FAIL on missing data

issues.title: Chat page sent /api/query with no Authorization header (guaranteed 401), no login UI existed, and the catch() branch rendered network errors as assistant answers
issues.test_evidence: next lint/tsc/build green; API contract covered by login/query integration tests; browser-level E2E not executed in this environment (BLOCKED: no browser)

issues.title: Evaluations router was three TODO stubs; pyproject declared a console script pointing at a nonexistent module, undeclared pypdf, and unused heavy deps (sentence-transformers pulled torch, python-jwt unused)
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_evaluations_api.py (3 tests)
issues.residual_risk: In-process eval runs are bounded by dataset size; no job queue (worker remains a poller stub - known gap)

issues.title: scripts/worker.py was a TODO poller (sleep loop); Redis was configured but no client existed
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_jobs_queue.py (8 reliable-queue mechanics tests) + tests/integration/test_ingest_jobs.py (6 end-to-end: 202 enqueue -> worker fetch/handle -> document in DB, 503 without Redis, pre-queue validation, owner/admin ACL, failed jobs, unknown kinds)
issues.residual_risk: Orphan recovery assumes a single worker replica (no heartbeat protocol); eval jobs are CLI-only until queued through the same dispatcher

issues.title: Clarify behavior and conflicting-source reporting were not implemented (eval rows permanently unscored)
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_clarify_conflict.py (17) + tests/integration/test_clarify_conflict_agent.py (3); full golden eval now scores 50/50 rows (agentic behavior 0.96, pattern 0.686)
issues.residual_risk: Offline conflict detection is a number+unit heuristic (days/week, $/period, weeks of leave, %); non-numeric conflicts need a real provider run

issues.title: No real-provider runtime validation of LLM judging, bge-m3 embeddings, or bge-reranker in this environment (no GPU, no real API key)
issues.test_evidence: Contract tests against documented API shapes; mock-mode end-to-end coverage
issues.residual_risk: First real-provider run may surface integration issues (auth, JSON strictness, model quirks); nightly CI job exercises real providers when secrets exist

issues.title: Python-artifact 'lib/' gitignore rule silently excluded apps/web/src/lib; commit d4ebc38 depended on src/lib/auth.ts but never committed it, so fresh clones could not build the web app
issues.test_evidence: git check-ignore exits 1 for the path; auth.ts tracked; full test matrix green on the repaired tree
issues.residual_risk: Other untracked-but-needed files would surface in the fresh-clone validation (performed clean)

issues.title: Refresh token was returned only in the JSON body and stored by the web client in localStorage (XSS-readable, 7-day lifetime); no rotation, no revocation, no logout endpoint
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_auth_refresh_rotation.py (8): HttpOnly cookie attributes, cookie-only refresh, rotation kills replayed tokens, reuse detection audited, logout revokes + clears, idempotency
issues.residual_risk: REFRESH_COOKIE_SECURE must be true behind TLS (default false for local http); access token remains in sessionStorage for the demo

issues.title: Failed-login rate limiting was in-memory only - 5 attempts per worker per process lifetime in multi-worker deployments
issues.test_evidence: tests/unit/test_rate_limit.py (10): both backends pinned to identical semantics via the shared FakeRedis double; factory fallback tests
issues.residual_risk: Backend is resolved once per process (no mid-flight Redis recovery); X-Forwarded-For still requires a trusted proxy

issues.title: Cost per retrieval event was never persisted; /admin/stats reported cost_usd_24h as hardcoded 0.0
issues.test_evidence: tests/integration/test_retrieval_event_cost.py: event row cost equals the API-reported cost; stats equals the DB sum
issues.residual_risk: Under the mock provider the cost is token-priced from the deterministic mock, not real spend

issues.title: Async ingest job payloads carry file content (base64) through Redis; fine at the 20 MB upload cap, but large-scale production should pass object-store pointers instead
issues.test_evidence: Design decision documented in core/jobs.py module docstring
issues.residual_risk: Redis memory pressure if the queue backs up with many large files; bounded by the upload cap and job TTL

issues.title: Content sniffing for uploads is best-effort (magic bytes for pdf/docx/html only); deep parser fuzzing not performed
issues.test_evidence: Documented in the original audit; unchanged
issues.residual_risk: A crafted file that satisfies the magic-byte check could still exercise parser edge cases
